title: Byrdpip
description: Upon pickup, gain the card Byrd Swoop. A Byrdpip will accompany you in battles.
flavor: Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...
notes: Upon pickup, all Byrdonus Egg cards in your deck and hand are transformed into Byrd Swoop cards. Summons a Byrdpip pet to accompany you in battle. This relic has four visual variants that are randomly selected upon pickup.
